candidate: H37a shared 36-stage full-coverage non-orthogonal GL2 task-atom fit-all capacity discriminator
purpose: Test whether shared full-coverage orientation plus bounded singular-value/shear freedom can fit the six leading-PC parts when applied to a basis-free task-gradient atom.

task_atom.formula: D_n(E) = NS5(gradient of fixed task loss with respect to W_n at W0)
task_atom.initialization: all raw block parameters zero, giving exact identity

fit.target: six-node leading PC of the centered registered 239-state trajectory
fit.normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for every task atom and PC part; normalize prediction only in the cosine objective
fit.algorithm: 64 deterministic full-batch Adam iterations maximizing mean smooth absolute cosine
fit.node_coefficients: post-fit optimal signed scalar; charged but not needed by the cosine optimizer

routing_after_pass: Write and preregister H37b using the identical blocks, prompt, permutations, initialization, optimizer, bounds, and state for six-fold leave-one-node-out transfer.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact shared full-coverage GL2 task-atom family and return to theory before a causally distinct carrier or alternate-manifold construction.
forbidden_followups: stage, prompt, gain-bound, or shear-bound sweep
